blueprint.summary: Hosted Postgres backend, including a lead store for enrichment jobs. Auth, edge functions and logs help; schema, roles and security need deliberate setup before anything faces outside users.
use_when: You need a real database behind an automation
You want hosted functions and logs in one place
avoid_when: Nobody will set up roles and row-level security

setup.do: Design tables, roles and row-level security before exposing anything to outside users.
Enable extensions such as pgvector or pg_cron from the dashboard when needed.

steps.do: Create the lead store schema and load records.
Run enrichment or sync jobs as edge functions, keeping each call short.
gotchas: Edge functions return 504 after the idle timeout

steps.do: Use the logs to check jobs after each run.

thresholds.name: Edge function CPU per request
thresholds.why: Longer CPU work is cut off

pitfalls.issue: Default setup is not safe for outside users
pitfalls.fix: Set roles and row-level security deliberately first

pitfalls.issue: Free projects pause after a week of inactivity
pitfalls.fix: Use a paid plan for anything that runs on a schedule

quality_bar: Row-level security on every exposed table

limits.note: 256 MB memory, an idle timeout and a wall-clock cap that is longer on paid plans
Two active projects with a small database each
